from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1][0]
    two = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2][0]
    r, c = one
    tr, tc = two
    sr = 0 if tr == r else (1 if tr > r else -1)
    sc = 0 if tc == c else (1 if tc > c else -1)
    while (r, c) != (tr, tc):
        dr, dc = abs(tr - r), abs(tc - c)
        if dr > 1 and dc > 1:
            r += sr
            c += sc
        elif dr > 1:
            r += sr
        elif dc > 1:
            c += sc
        else:
            r, c = tr, tc
        if (r, c) != (tr, tc):
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
program_path = program_dir / 'task-e87021f1.py'
program_path.write_text(source)
ns = {}
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), ns)
transform = ns['transform']
# Demo 1 exact expected marked positions and endpoints.

out2 = transform(g2)
expected2 = {(12,7),(11,6),(10,5),(9,4),(8,3),(7,2)} | {(r,2) for r in range(2,7)}
actual2 = {(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(out2) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3}
assert actual2 == expected2 and out2[1][1]==2 and out2[13][8]==1, (actual2, expected2)
# Apply to test input.
test = [[0]*16 for _ in range(16)]; test[1][4]=1; test[13][12]=2
test_out = transform(test)
print('demo checks pass:', len(actual1), len(actual2)); print('output:'); print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in test_out))
